REAL, PUBLISHED OTH building designations. Not derived, not invented. Scraped 2026-07-30 from the university's own 'Standort und Raumpläne' page, which lists every building letter and who sits in it.

⚠️ THIS CORRECTS A CLAIM THIS PROJECT MADE. The timetable generator assigned building letters deterministically and badged them `derived` with the note "OTH's real letters are not public". That was simply false — they are published, with occupants, on the main website. The room codes OSM already carries (K 001 Großer Hörsaal, K 006 CIP-Pool) line up exactly with Gebäude K = Fakultät Informatik und Mathematik, which is the cross-check that the mapping below is right.

roomCodeFormat.$comment: Confirmed against a real OTH event listing: 'OTH Regensburg, Raum D002 (Galgenbergstr. 30)'. Letter + three digits, NO space. The earlier pattern allowed an optional space because the OSM indoor labels are written 'K 001'; the official form has none, so the ingest must tolerate both and normalise to the official one.

plans.$comment: Site plans showing building letters and outlines. They are NOT per-floor room plans — the interior layout still has to be generated and badged. Asking OTH for the CAFM floor plans remains open question §9.1.

$modelledFaculties.$comment: ⚠️ NOW REAL RATHER THAN INVENTED. The synthetic dataset previously assigned buildings to faculties arbitrarily so that a shared hall and a cross-campus Praktikum would exist. The published plan says where these two faculties actually sit: Informatik und Mathematik in K (Galgenbergstraße 32), Maschinenbau in A/B/C (Galgenbergstraße 30) and sharing I in the Haus der Technik. The lecture halls in D/E (Hörsaalgebäude am Forum) are central, which is exactly the shared-hall competition the product is about — and that part turns out to be true rather than staged.
